title: Insurance renewal portal: reference backlog
summary: Phase 1: online renewal of home and motor policies, the agent worklist and online payment of the first instalment.

epics.summary: Policyholders renew home and motor policies online
epics.outcome: Policyholders view and accept their renewal quote in the portal, reducing renewal calls by 40% within 12 months.
epics.scopeNotes: Mid-term adjustments are out of scope for phase 1.

stories.summary: View my renewal quote in the portal
stories.want: to see the renewal quote for each of my policies before it arrives by post
stories.benefit: I can decide early whether to renew

acceptanceCriteria.given: a policyholder with a policy expiring in 40 days and a quote issued by the PAS
acceptanceCriteria.when: they open the policy in the portal
acceptanceCriteria.then: the new premium, cover and start date from the PAS quote are shown
both policies and their renewal status are listed

acceptanceCriteria.given: the PAS quote service is unavailable
acceptanceCriteria.then: a message asks them to try later and no stale premium is shown

stories.want: to accept my renewal quote in the portal
stories.benefit: I stay covered without calling an agent

acceptanceCriteria.then: the acceptance is sent to the PAS and a confirmation is shown and emailed
online renewal is not offered and they are told to contact their broker

acceptanceCriteria.given: a renewal premium more than 20% above the current premium
acceptanceCriteria.then: online renewal is not offered and a call-back task is created for a renewals agent

stories.summary: Pay the first instalment through the hosted payment page
stories.want: to pay my first instalment when I accept my renewal
stories.benefit: my renewal is complete in one visit

acceptanceCriteria.then: they are sent to the provider's hosted payment page and no card data reaches Salesforce

acceptanceCriteria.when: the policyholder returns to the portal
acceptanceCriteria.then: the renewal stays pending and they can retry

nonFunctional: Card data is never stored or processed in Salesforce (PCI DSS scope)

epics.summary: Renewals agents work a 30-day renewal list
epics.outcome: Renewals agents see which policies renew in the next 30 days and which customers need a call.

stories.summary: See policies due for renewal in the next 30 days
stories.want: a list of my policies renewing in the next 30 days and whether the customer has acted
stories.benefit: I call the right customers first

acceptanceCriteria.when: the agent opens the renewal list
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the policies expiring in 10 and 25 days are shown, soonest first
that policy is marked as renewed

stories.summary: Get a task when a customer abandons an online renewal
stories.want: a task when a policyholder starts but does not finish an online renewal
stories.benefit: I can help them before the policy lapses

acceptanceCriteria.given: a policyholder who opened the renewal but did not accept within 2 days
acceptanceCriteria.then: one task is created for the policy owner with the policy and quote details

epics.outcome: The portal meets InfoSec's go-live requirements.

stories.want: every policyholder login to use multi-factor authentication
stories.benefit: accounts stay protected if a password leaks

acceptanceCriteria.when: they log in with a correct password
acceptanceCriteria.then: they must complete a second factor before seeing any data

stories.summary: Policyholders see only their own policies and documents
stories.want: policyholders to access only their own policies and documents
stories.benefit: no customer can see another customer's data

acceptanceCriteria.when: one requests the other's policy or document by URL or id
acceptanceCriteria.then: access is denied and nothing is shown

stories.summary: Keep an audit trail of logins and renewal acceptances for 7 years
stories.want: portal logins and renewal acceptances recorded and kept for 7 years
stories.benefit: we can prove who accepted what and when

acceptanceCriteria.when: an auditor queries it 7 years later
acceptanceCriteria.then: the policyholder, time and quote accepted are retrievable

nonFunctional: Personal data encrypted at rest, confirm with InfoSec whether platform encryption is sufficient

stories.summary: Pass a penetration test before go-live
stories.benefit: vulnerabilities are fixed before customers use it

acceptanceCriteria.then: no critical or high findings remain open

epics.summary: Renewal quote integration with the PAS
epics.outcome: The portal shows reliable renewal quotes from the PAS during the December peak.

stories.summary: Spike: PAS renewal quote API at peak load
stories.want: to measure the PAS quote API at 4,000 renewals a day and decide between live calls and a cached copy
stories.benefit: the portal stays responsive in December

acceptanceCriteria.when: it is load-tested at peak volume
acceptanceCriteria.then: the chosen approach and its measured response times are recorded in the design

assumptions: Policies continue to sync nightly from the PAS into Policy__c.

openQuestions.question: Does InfoSec require customer-managed keys or field-level encryption beyond the platform's encryption at rest?
